data.name: Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator
data.detailed_description:
In Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator, investigate a noir-inspired conspiracy through neon-lit streets, motels, bars, warehouses, and ruined landmarks. Decide how far you’re willing to go to uncover the truth.

🔎 Investigate the Case

Use Detective Vision to uncover hidden clues, inspect crime scenes, and reveal secrets others want to keep buried. Combine evidence in your case journal to unlock new objectives, discoveries, and dialogue paths.

🌃 Stealth Through a Dangerous City

Not every answer can be found in the open. Hide in shadows, distract guards, slip through back routes, and silently eliminate threats as you move deeper into restricted areas.

🔫 Limited Combat, High Stakes

When stealth fails, survival becomes personal. Use close-quarters attacks and a six-shot revolver where every bullet matters and every mistake has consequences.

🧩 Solve Environmental Puzzles

Crack safes, unlock hidden routes, inspect coded messages, and interact with the environment to progress through the investigation.

⚖️ Make Choices That Shape the Story

The truth is never simple. Bribe a witness, destroy evidence, protect a suspect, or expose the people in power. Your decisions affect key relationships and determine how the story ends.

🎭 A City Full of Secrets

Meet unforgettable characters, including a corrupt sheriff, a dangerous femme fatale, and an idealistic journalist - each with their own motives, loyalties, and role in the conspiracy.

In Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator, truth comes at a cost.
